intro.title: Build pagination filter sort API pattern
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a REST API endpoint that supports pagination, filtering, and sorting for a list of data. You'll learn how to handle query parameters to control the number of results, filter by specific fields, and sort the output. The core concept involves processing HTTP request queries and applying them to manipulate an in-memory dataset. You'll use Node.js with its built-in modules to create a server and manage the API logic. By the end, you'll have a functional API that can efficiently return tailored data based on user input.
intro.usecase: Pagination, filtering, and sorting are fundamental patterns in data-driven applications where users need to navigate large datasets efficiently. You'll find this pattern in e-commerce product listings where customers filter by category, sort by price, and browse through pages of results. It's equally essential in admin dashboards displaying user records, analytics platforms showing metrics, or content management systems organizing articles. As a backend developer, implementing robust pagination-filter-sort APIs ensures your applications remain performant and scalable while providing intuitive data exploration experiences.
